Scenario: Account admin exports invoices from the last 90 days as CSV
Given I am signed in as an account admin
And I am viewing the invoice list
When I export the invoice list as CSV
Then a CSV file is downloaded
And the file contains only invoices dated within the last 90 days
And each row includes the invoice number, customer name, amount and status

Scenario: Invoices older than 90 days are excluded from the export
Given I am signed in as an account admin
And an invoice dated 91 days ago exists
When I export the invoice list as CSV
Then the exported file does not contain that invoice

Scenario: Export with no invoices in the last 90 days produces a header-only CSV
Given I am signed in as an account admin
And no invoices exist from the last 90 days
When I export the invoice list as CSV
Then a CSV file is downloaded
And the file contains the column header row and no data rows

Scenario: Non-admin users cannot export the invoice list
Given I am signed in as a user who is not an account admin
When I attempt to export the invoice list as CSV
Then the export is not performed
And I see a message that I do not have permission to export invoices

Scenario: Shop owner uploads a PNG logo of at most 2 MB
Given I am signed in as a shop owner
When I upload a PNG logo file of 2 MB or smaller
Then the logo is saved to my shop's branding settings
And the logo is shown in the branding preview

Scenario: Shop owner uploads an SVG logo of at most 2 MB
Given I am signed in as a shop owner
When I upload an SVG logo file of 2 MB or smaller
Then the logo is saved to my shop's branding settings
And the logo is shown in the branding preview

Scenario: Logo upload is rejected when the file is not PNG or SVG
Given I am signed in as a shop owner
When I upload a JPG logo file
Then the upload is rejected
And I see a message that logos must be PNG or SVG files

Scenario: Logo upload is rejected when the file is larger than 2 MB
Given I am signed in as a shop owner
When I upload a PNG logo file larger than 2 MB
Then the upload is rejected
And I see a message that logos must be 2 MB or smaller

Scenario: Shop owner picks a brand color for invoice headers
Given I am signed in as a shop owner
When I choose a brand color for invoice headers
And I save my branding settings
Then the chosen color is saved to my shop's branding settings
And the color is shown in the branding preview

Scenario: Uploaded logo appears on invoices created after the change
Given I am signed in as a shop owner
And I have saved a logo and a brand color
When I create a new invoice
Then the invoice shows my logo
And the invoice header uses my brand color

Scenario: Branding changes do not alter invoices created before the change
Given I am signed in as a shop owner
And an invoice was created before I changed my logo or brand color
When I change my logo or brand color
Then that existing invoice still shows the logo and brand color it had when it was created
output.description: Two related invoice features. First, account admins need to export the invoice list as a CSV file limited to invoices from the last 90 days, with invoice number, customer name, amount and status for each row. Second, shop owners need to customise invoices by uploading a logo (PNG or SVG, max 2 MB) and choosing a brand color for invoice headers. Branding changes apply only to invoices created after the change, so existing invoices keep their original look.
output.title: Invoices: admin CSV export (last 90 days) and shop invoice branding

output.acceptance_criteria:
Feature: Session timeout settings and scheduled P&L report emails

Scenario: Session expires after the default 30 minutes of inactivity
Given a user is logged in and has not changed any session timeout setting
When the user is inactive for 30 minutes
Then the user's session expires and the user is logged out

Scenario: Custom session timeout can be set within the allowed range
Given an admin is on the session settings page
When the admin sets the inactivity timeout to a value from 15 minutes to 8 hours inclusive
Then the new timeout is saved and applies to subsequent sessions

Scenario: Custom session timeout outside the allowed range is rejected
Given an admin is on the session settings page
When the admin attempts to set the inactivity timeout to less than 15 minutes or more than 8 hours
Then the setting is not saved and an error message states the allowed range of 15 minutes to 8 hours

Scenario: User is warned before being logged out for inactivity
Given a user is logged in and has unsaved work in an invoice
When the user has been inactive for a period shortly before the session timeout
Then the user sees a warning that the session is about to expire and can choose to stay logged in

Scenario: Unsaved invoice work is preserved when the session expires
Given a user has a half-written invoice and the session expires due to inactivity
When the user logs in again
Then the user can recover the half-written invoice without losing the entered data

Scenario: User schedules the profit and loss report to be emailed every Monday
Given a user has access to the profit and loss report
When the user schedules the report to be emailed every Monday
Then the schedule is saved and the report is emailed every Monday

Scenario: Scheduled report can have up to 5 recipients
Given a user is creating or editing a scheduled profit and loss report
When the user adds recipient email addresses
Then up to 5 recipients can be added to the scheduled report

Scenario: Scheduled report is rejected when more than 5 recipients are added
Given a user is creating or editing a scheduled profit and loss report with 5 recipients
When the user attempts to add a sixth recipient
Then the recipient is not added and an error message states the maximum of 5 recipients

Scenario: Recipients receive the scheduled report without logging in
Given a scheduled profit and loss report has recipients who do not have accounts or are not logged in
When the scheduled Monday email is sent
Then each recipient receives the report by email and can read it on a mobile phone without logging in
output.description: Two related asks from Leila. First, sessions should expire after 30 minutes of inactivity by default, and admins need to be able to set a custom inactivity timeout between 15 minutes and 8 hours. Users should get notice before being logged out so half-written invoices are not lost. Second, users should be able to schedule the profit and loss report to be emailed every Monday, with up to 5 recipients per scheduled report. Recipients who do not log in must still be able to receive and read the report on their phones.
output.title: Session timeout settings and scheduled P&L report emails

output.acceptance_criteria:
Feature: Late fees on overdue invoices and full workspace data export

Scenario: Configure a flat late fee
Given I am a workspace owner
When I set the late fee type to "flat" and enter a flat fee amount
Then the late fee setting is saved and applies to future overdue invoices

Scenario: Configure a percentage late fee
Given I am a workspace owner
When I set the late fee type to "percentage" and enter a percentage of the balance
Then the late fee setting is saved and applies to future overdue invoices

Scenario: Flat late fee is added once when an invoice becomes overdue
Given a late fee of a flat amount is configured
And an invoice with an outstanding balance passes its due date
When the overdue check runs
Then the flat late fee is added to the invoice
And the invoice total increases by exactly the flat amount

Scenario: Percentage late fee is calculated on the outstanding balance
Given a late fee of a percentage is configured
And an invoice with an outstanding balance of 1000 passes its due date
When the overdue check runs
Then the late fee equals the configured percentage of 1000
And the late fee is added to the invoice once

Scenario: Late fee is never applied more than once to the same invoice
Given an overdue invoice already has a late fee applied
When the overdue check runs again
Or the overdue check runs on any later day
Then no additional late fee is added to that invoice

Scenario: No late fee before the due date
Given a late fee is configured
And an invoice has not yet passed its due date
When the overdue check runs
Then no late fee is added to the invoice

Scenario: Request a full workspace data export
Given I am a workspace admin
When I request a full export of all workspace data
Then the export is generated and includes all workspace data
And I am notified when the export is ready

Scenario: Export is delivered as a ZIP of CSV files
Given a full export has been generated
When I download the export
Then the file is a ZIP archive
And the ZIP contains one CSV file per data type

Scenario: Export download link expires
Given a full export is ready for download
When 24 hours have passed since the link was generated
Then the download link no longer works
And the export file is deleted from storage

Scenario: Only workspace admins can request and download exports
Given I am not a workspace admin
When I attempt to request or download a full workspace export
Then the request is denied
And no export data is returned
output.description: Two related requests for the billing and admin areas. First, workspace owners can configure an automatic late fee on overdue invoices, either as a flat amount or as a percentage of the outstanding balance. Each overdue invoice is charged the fee only once, which prevents the duplicate penalties a customer reported last year. Second, workspace admins can request a full export of all workspace data, delivered as a ZIP of CSV files via a download link that expires, so financial data is not left accessible indefinitely.
output.title: Invoices: automatic late fees and full workspace data export as CSV ZIP

output.acceptance_criteria:
Feature: Saved products and partial payments on invoices

Scenario: Shop owner saves a product with name, unit price and SKU
Given I am a signed-in shop owner
When I save a product with the name "Ceramic mug", unit price 12.50 and SKU "MUG-001"
Then the product "Ceramic mug" is saved with unit price 12.50 and SKU "MUG-001"

Scenario: Saving a product requires a name, unit price and SKU
Given I am a signed-in shop owner
When I try to save a product with no SKU
Then the product is not saved
And I see a message that name, unit price and SKU are required

Scenario: Shop owner adds a saved product to an invoice by typing part of its name
Given I am a signed-in shop owner with a saved product "Ceramic mug"
And I am editing an invoice
When I type "mug" in the product field
Then "Ceramic mug" appears in the suggestions
When I select "Ceramic mug"
Then a line item for "Ceramic mug" is added to the invoice at its saved unit price

Scenario: Changing a product's price does not change existing invoices
Given an invoice issued with "Ceramic mug" at unit price 12.50
When the shop owner changes the saved unit price of "Ceramic mug" to 14.00
Then the existing invoice still shows unit price 12.50 and its original total

Scenario: New invoices use the updated product price
Given the saved unit price of "Ceramic mug" is 14.00
When the shop owner adds "Ceramic mug" to a new invoice
Then the line item uses unit price 14.00

Scenario: Bookkeeper records a partial payment against an invoice
Given a bookkeeper is viewing an unpaid invoice with total 100.00
When the bookkeeper records a partial payment of 40.00
Then the payment of 40.00 is saved against the invoice
And the invoice shows a remaining balance of 60.00
And the invoice status is "Partially paid"

Scenario: Invoice is marked paid only when the full balance is paid
Given an invoice with total 100.00 and a recorded partial payment of 40.00
When the bookkeeper records a further payment of 60.00
Then the remaining balance is 0.00
And the invoice status is "Paid"

Scenario: Each partial payment is listed with the remaining balance after it
Given an invoice with total 100.00
When the bookkeeper records payments of 40.00 and then 25.00
Then the invoice shows a payment of 40.00 with remaining balance 60.00
And the invoice shows a payment of 25.00 with remaining balance 35.00

Scenario: Payment cannot exceed the remaining balance
Given an invoice with a remaining balance of 60.00
When the bookkeeper tries to record a payment of 70.00
Then the payment is not saved
And I see a message that the payment exceeds the remaining balance of 60.00
output.description: Shop owners need to save products (name, unit price, SKU) and add them to invoices by typing part of the product name. Invoices must keep the unit price they were issued at, so a later price change does not alter old invoices. Bookkeepers also need to record partial payments against an invoice, with the remaining balance shown after each payment, so invoices do not show as paid after a single instalment.
output.title: Invoices: saved products and partial payments with remaining balance
